Subject: SIG questionnaire — evidence handoff and access

Rachel —

Thanks again for the time today. As discussed, the security team needs a short package of artifacts to complete our SIG review:

- IAM runbooks (user provisioning / deprovisioning)
- KMS / key rotation evidence or procedure
- Network diagram showing segmentation for production
- Console screenshots for audit export activity (last 12 months)
- A brief statement on data retention policy for customer tokens/logs

Can you share these via a secure Drive folder with viewer links that expire? If any items are sensitive, a redacted PDF is fine. We may request a short video walkthrough if something is unclear.

Appreciate it — goal is to close the SIG by next week.

Elena

Pinebrook Bank
